claim: The widget holds 1 to 12 reorderable cards with a title, teaser and button
Each card opens something already built on the same page, chosen from a searchable list; new content is saved first
The detail opens in a pop-up or slides in from the side
Closing returns the visitor to the same place on the page
Rearranging the page does not break a card
Targets are limited to the same page
